title: Come Undone | Community Breathwork in Denver Metro
description: A sacred, 2-hour journey, designed to ignite your inner light through the ancient practice of rhythmic breathwork.
long_description:
A sacred, 2-hour journey, designed to ignite your inner light through the ancient practice of rhythmic breathwork.

About this Event

This is a two-hour community ceremony using the modality of holotropic breathwork. No experience required. No performance expected.
Just you, your breath, and up to fourteen people doing the same brave thing.
We'll use breath, music, and light movement to support you in accessing what's sitting underneath the surface — old stories, stuck emotion, the stuff that talking doesn't always reach.
The flow:
Arrive up to 10 minutes prior to the official start to get settledA grounded introduction to breathwork and this particular styleCo-created safety: share your name, where you're at, and your intention if you'd likeActive breathing to a curated playlist that carries you through the experienceAn optional release moment — scream, tap, hum, sing, shake — whatever your body asks forIntegration time: rest, write, draw, and/or verbally connect with the groupWhat this might bring up:
Holotropic breathwork works with the body's own intelligence. You might feel emotional, physical, or somewhere in between. You might cry, laugh, feel nothing, or feel everything. All of it is welcome. Nothing needs to be performed or produced. In here, we let the body body.
This is a space to process, not to present, perform or perfect.
What to bring:
Comfortable, non-restrictive clothingYoga mat or a surface you can lie on for a couple of hoursBlanketPillow or bolster (doubles as your scream buffer, no shame)Journal, pen, colored pencils Eye coverWaterChaptstick, vaselineCrystals, cards, totems, etc

Victoria Cumberbatch is a PCC level ADHD resilience coach, holotropic breathwork facilitator, and the founder of Victorious Coaching. Her approach blends somatics, cognitive behaviorism, cultural intersectionality all through a neurodivergent lens. Find more at victoriouscoach.com/linkz.

long_description:
An unforgettable evening of desi glam, entertainment, inspiring stories, and community—all in support of meaningful impact

About this Event

Retro Raat: A Night of Desi Glam

An unforgettable evening of Desi glam, inspiring stories, meaningful connections, and community coming together for impact. Join us for the 16th Annual AIF BAYP Charity Gala, where timeless retro elegance meets purpose.

Retro Raat: A Night of Desi Glam brings together Bay Area young professionals, community leaders, and changemakers for an evening of celebration, connection, and giving.

War Memorial Opera House, San Francisco
August 29, 2026
7:00 PM

Come together with a community committed to making a difference while supporting a cause that creates lasting change. This year, proceeds from the Gala will support Project MANSI, AIF’s award-winning maternal and newborn health initiative, helping improve access to quality healthcare for vulnerable mothers and babies across India.
Dress in your finest retro-inspired attire and join us for a night where style, purpose, and community come together to make a meaningful impact.

About the American India Foundation
The American India Foundation is committed to catalyzing social and economic change in India, and building a lasting bridge between the United States and India through high-impact interventions in education, livelihoods, public health, and leadership development. AIF’s programming seeks to achieve gender equity through developing inclusive models that focus on and empower girls and women. Founded in 2001 at the initiative of President Bill Clinton following a suggestion from Indian Prime Minister Vajpayee, AIF has impacted the lives of ~19 million of India’s poor. With offices in New York and California, twelve chapters across the U.S., and India operations headquartered in New Delhi, AIF is transforming lives across 24 states of India while addressing these issues on a regional, country, and international scale. Learn more at www.AIF.org.

title: Candlelit Reset™: An Evening of Yoga, Breathwork and Deep Relaxation
description: Candlelit breathwork, gentle yoga, and deep relaxation to help you unwind, reset, and leave grounded and restored.
long_description:
Candlelit breathwork, gentle yoga, and deep relaxation to help you unwind, reset, and leave grounded and restored.

About this Event

Step into a candlelit sanctuary intentionally designed to help you slow down, reconnect, and restore.
Through mindful breathwork, gentle Hatha yoga, and guided relaxation, you’ll be invited into a slower rhythm, one that allows the body to soften, the mind to settle, and the nervous system to unwind. Surrounded by the warm glow of candlelight and calming instrumental music, every element of the evening has been intentionally curated for you, down to details you’ll only discover once you arrive.
The evening unfolds as one continuous journey: guided breathwork and meditation to quiet the day, a gentle beginner-friendly yoga flow to release tension, and an extended full-body relaxation to close. In the final moments, you’ll receive a cooling aromatherapy towel prepared in your choice of lavender or peppermint, one last invitation to release the day before returning home.
Whether you’re stepping onto a mat for the very first time or returning to a long-loved practice, you are welcome exactly as you are. Modifications are offered throughout, and nothing is ever asked of you but presence.
Come as you are. Leave grounded, restored, and renewed.
The day will ask everything of you. This hour asks nothing.
Come lay it all down: the noise, the pace, the weight you didn’t realize you were carrying. Breathe by candlelight. Move slowly, softly, honestly. Rest deeper than you have in a long while.
Your mat is waiting. Reserve your space at the inaugural Candlelit Reset™.

description: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening Classes will guide you through complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual wisdom. Our weekly live Zoom classes will guide you through the complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual knowledge. The Bhagavad Gita, a dialogue between Krishna (the teacher) and Arjuna (the student), addresses life's deepest questions: What is the nature of the Self? What is the highest purpose of existence? organizer: Mantra House Kirtan Bhakti Yoga Meditation and More
long_description:
The Bhagavad Gita is one of the most influential and enduring texts of yoga philosophy, dating back over 2,000 years. Long before yoga became associated primarily with physical
postures, the Gita explored the inner science of action, awareness, and purpose. It offers a framework not just for practice-but for living.

We do this through:

•Gentle Yoga and embodiment
•Breath practices for clarity and grounding
•Art therapy to process insight
•Bite-sized Gita wisdom explained in modern language
•Guided reflection for personal application
•Journalling and Tea circles
No prior knowledge of the Gita is required.

This is not a lecture or traditional study circle - it is a lived experience of timeless wisdom made accessible for modern life.

This offering is designed for:

•Spiritually curious individuals
•Yoga practitioners seeking philosophical depth
•Those exploring meaning and purpose
•People feeling stuck in overthinking or indecision
•Community members wanting interactive spiritual exploration
For those both familiar with and brand new to Bhakti Yoga (Indian and non-Indian
Backgrounds)
The tone is inclusive, accessible, and welcoming to all backgrounds.

-Asana trains the body.

-Pranayama refines the breath.

-But the Gita trains the mind, intention, and inner orientation.

The Gita expands on essential yogic principles often mentioned in the Yoga Sutras of Patanjali:

• Acting without attachment to results (karma yoga)

• Steadying the mind in uncertainty

• Sustaining effort without burnout

• Aligning action with dharma - purposeful living

While many yoga classes strengthen the body, Living the Gita explores how yogic wisdom

shapes decision-making, resilience, and clarity in everyday life. This 90-minute multi-sensory experience weaves movement, creativity, reflection, and dialogue to bring these
teachings off the page and into embodied practice.

This is yoga off the mat - not just how we move, but how we choose, respond, and live.

long_description:
A FREE outdoor yoga integrating all 7 chakras through movement, breath and mindful practice. Open to all levels.

About this Event

Expand & Embody is a FREE outdoor yoga series rooted in the belief that yoga isn’t just something we do on the mat. It’s a practice that helps us move through life with greater awareness, resilience, and ease.

Each class explores a different theme through intentional movement, breath, and reflection, creating space to strengthen both the body and the nervous system. Whether you’re brand new to yoga or have an established practice, you’ll be guided through an experience designed to leave you feeling more grounded, more present, and more capable of meeting life beyond the mat.

Class 8: Embodying (Full Chakra Activation)
Our final class brings together everything we’ve explored throughout the series. Rather than focusing on a single energy center, we’ll move through a full chakra practice that honors the interconnectedness of the body, mind, and breath. Through intentional movement, breath, and mindful awareness, we’ll revisit the themes of grounding, feeling, empowering, connecting, expressing, seeing, and expanding, weaving them into one integrated experience. This practice reminds us that embodiment isn’t about mastering yoga, it’s about allowing what we’ve practiced on the mat to become part of how we move through everyday life.

Nigam has sung in various Indian languages and has been lauded with prestigious awards, including a nomination for the Oscars in 2015. His unique voice and exceptional talent have made him one of the highest-paid singers in the industry, and his presence at the Revolution Tour 2026 is set to make the event unforgettable.
Experience the Grandeur of Dolby Theatre
The Dolby Theatre, located at 6801 Hollywood Boulevard in Los Angeles, CA, United States, is renowned for hosting high-profile events. This iconic venue assures safety, accessibility, and comfort to all its guests. Its location in Hollywood offers a plethora of attractions, including historic sites and trendy boutiques. Parking is available on-site for your convenience. Enjoy a pre-show dinner at one of the nearby Indian restaurants, offering a variety of authentic dishes that perfectly complement the evening.
Secure Your Seat for the Musical Extravaganza

long_description:
NOTE: Hybrid event, speaker is virtual

Azure DocumentDB brings a flexible, open-source MongoDB-compatible document database that is actually compatible with other cloud providers.
In this 50-minute session, we’ll unpack Azure DocumentDB from the perspective of a SQL and MongoDB professional. You’ll learn
\- how DocumentDB’s architecture works including its Postgres foundation and MongoDB wire\-protocol compatibility
\- how its JSON document model compares to relational data design
\- where transactions\, indexing\, and consistency behave differently or same as SQL Server\.
\- scaling\, global distribution\, security\, and indexing strategies\.
We’ll walk step-by-step from familiar T-SQL concepts into the DocumentDB world: inserting schema-free documents, querying with MongoDB operators, tuning performance with indexes and the Index Advisor, and scaling a cluster in the Azure Portal. We’ll also compare DocumentDB to MongoDB and discuss if/when DocumentDB is the better operational choice on Azure (and other clouds).
Whether you're supporting enterprise SQL workloads, considering NoSQL for new microservices, or evaluating MongoDB alternatives, this session will give you a practical mental model, concrete examples, and a clear understanding of how (and when) to use Azure DocumentDB effectively.

long_description:
**Presenter:** Matthew Hess, Microsoft MVP
**Time:** Pizza at 6:00, Presentation Starts at 6:30pm Eastern
**Location:** Theoris, 9000 Keystone Crossing, Either Downstairs or in Suite 230 if main meeting room isn't available, Indianapolis

As a C# developer, it can be a challenge to keep up with all the new language features that Microsoft gives us. Old code still compiles, and old habits die hard. In this presentation we'll look at some of my very favorite new(ish) language features. These are things I use every day:

• Pattern Matching Switch Expressions (C# 8 and C# 9) - So versatile
• Target Typed New Constructors (C# 9) - Say goodbye to "var"
• Value Tuples (C# 7) - Underutilized and powerful
• String Interpolation (C# 6) - Not really new, but are you using it?
• Collection Expressions with Spread (C# 12) - Even easier initialization
• Null Conditional Assignment (C# 14) - At last!

Looking forward to seeing you there!

long_description:
Breaking the Stigma: Yoga will be a community experience that combines conversation, connection, food, and practice.

About this Event

We will begin by sharing a meal and engaging in conversation with yoga practitioners. Together, we will explore questions about the history and spiritual significance of yoga, how the practice has evolved, and what it means to engage with yoga in today's world.
We will then close the gathering with an accessible yoga practice led by a trusted local yoga instructor, giving participants an opportunity to intentionally engage with the practice after learning more about its history and context.
Through both conversation and practice, we hope to break down stigmas and misconceptions about yoga—what it is, what it is not, and how it may support an individual's physical, emotional, mental, and spiritual well-being.
Most importantly, this is an opportunity to ask questions, learn from one another, and explore whether yoga can be a meaningful part of our own healing and wellness journeys.

Ancient cradle songs for a world that needs to rest — woven through an evening of gentle movement, breath, and live music. Come as you are.

About this Event

Rest & Renewal
An evening of movement & sound
Ancient cradle songs for a world that needs to rest — woven through an evening of gentle movement, breath, and live music.
For one night, The Pad Studios becomes a place to set things down. Nicole Cronin guides a slow, accessible practice built around breath and release — nothing to push through, nothing to achieve. Alongside her, Lucía Lilikoi sings live: lullabies drawn from old traditions, sung in the dark, carrying the same intention they always have. To quiet. To soften. To let someone else hold the night for a while.
No experience is needed, and no part of this asks anything of you. Arrive tired. Arrive tender. Move as much or as little as you like — some people will follow every cue, some will lie down and simply listen. Both are the practice.
What to expect
· Gentle, all-levels yoga — slow pacing, long holds, plenty of support
· Live voice and instruments throughout, played in the room with you
· A closing rest held in song
Bring a mat, and anything that makes the floor feel kind — a blanket, a cushion, warm layers. Space is limited, so early booking is encouraged.
Come as you are. Leave restored.
Nicole Cronin — yoga teacher & guide
Lucía Lilikoi — singer, composer & sound practitioner

Join us for a morning of hands-on, family-friendly activities, fun games, and trail walks. Don’t miss the highlight of the day - a live raptor program, where you can see our incredible ambassador birds up close and learn about their vital role in the ecosystem.

It’s a perfect way for families to connect with nature, get inspired, and make lasting memories while supporting wildlife conservation!

Every First Saturday has a unique theme! September's theme is: Keep Calm and Carrion

Themed activities include: 

Yoga on the Prairie

Scavenger Hunt with a Twist

Face Painting

Photo Ops

Education Stations

Raptor Program

Prairie Walk

Enrichment Building

Create Seed Packets or Seed Bombs

Agents of Discovery

More!

Join us for a new additional opportunity! Start your morning with a guided Bird Walk led by the Prairies & Timbers Audubon Society at 7:30AM. Explore the prairie with experienced birders and enjoy a peaceful visit to our bird blind water feature, where you can observe a variety of native birds up close in their natural habitat. After that, join us for the official First Saturday event! 

📸 Photography is welcome — capture your magical moments with our raptors!

In partnership with Sensory Days Dallas, a Quiet Area with sensory-friendly activities will be available at all family events.

All ticket sales directly support the Blackland Prairie Raptor Center. As a small, self-sustaining nonprofit, events like this - and the generosity of friends like you - help us care for our raptors, protect the Blackland Prairie, and offer educational programs for families. If you’d like to support our work even further, we’d be truly grateful for any donation at bpraptorcenter.org/donate.

A Note About Weather:

title: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening
description: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening Classes will guide you through complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual wisdom. An ongoing in-depth course deliving into profound wisdom within Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Hindu/Indian/Vedic spiritual philosophy, and Upanishads. You can see prior recordings at: YesVedanta.com/bg2 Timeless Wisdom of Bhagavad Gita: A Complete Course in Non-Duality in 700 Verses Join us for an in-depth exploration of the Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Vedantic wisdom. Our weekly live Zoom classes will guide you through the complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual knowledge. The Bhagavad Gita, a dialogue between Krishna (the teacher) and Arjuna (the student), addresses life's deepest questions: What is the nature of the Self? What is the highest purpose of existence? How can one live with intelligence and clarity? If all existence is One, why do we perceive differences? What is the nature of the universe and its origin? long_description:
SOMATIC RELEASE *SOUND BATH* blends therapeutic sound, vibration, and gentle body-based awareness practices to calm the nervous system and release stored physical, mental, and emotional tension. 

This monthly practice opens with PMR (Progressive Muscle Relaxation) techniques to ease the body before surrendering to the resonance of crystal singing bowls, harp, hypnotic percussion, and soft guidance into a state of deep relaxation. Somatic sound therapy can help you unblock survival energies — such as fight, flight, or freeze responses — that became trapped during overwhelming or traumatic events.

Whether you’re seeking rest, clarity, nervous system support, or simply a moment to reconnect with yourself, this workshop offers a safe and nurturing space. All bodies and all identities are welcome — whether you’re new to sound baths or returning to venture deeper.

ABOUT THE INSTRUCTOR: Charlie Sebastian Short is a certified sound practitioner, musician, and caregiver based in Portland. His work draws from the Quantum Sound Method, classical music training, and years of supporting both humans and animals with patience and care. He approaches sound healing as nervous system support, using harmonious instruments to encourage rest, calm, and emotional ease. As a mixed-race, LGBTQIA+, and neurodivergent practitioner, Charlie creates an inclusive space where all bodies and identities can access comfort and relaxation.

The autumn magic is blooming, goddesses! 🍁✨ This **Labor Day**, we’re trading the usual holiday routine for flowers, sunshine, garden wandering, and some very important **chicken business.** 🐔💅

title: Yoga @ Wiggle
description: BREATHE, STRETCH, RELEASE.
long_description:
BREATHE, STRETCH, RELEASE.

About this Event

Yoga at Wiggle is a welcoming weekly yoga experience designed to help participants reconnect with their bodies, regulate their nervous systems, build strength and mobility, and begin the week feeling grounded. Each class offers a unique style while maintaining the same warm, community-centered atmosphere.

 https://cdn-az.allevents.in/events3/banners/71bacce0-91e2-11f1-bae3-ff7b876e3a8d-rimg-w557-h740-dcd8c8c8-gmir.jpg 

Danielle Branche-Brown serves as the lead and primary yoga instructor, guiding most weekly classes. To bring fresh perspectives and styles to our community, guest yoga instructors will lead class at least once each month, giving participants the opportunity to experience a variety of teaching styles and yoga traditions while maintaining the welcoming, community-centered spirit of Yoga at Wiggle.

Each week offers something a little different, including:

- Yin Yoga
- Yang Yoga
- Yin-Yang Fusion
- Vinyasa Flow
- Slow Flow
- Gentle Yoga
- Restorative Yoga
- Mobility & Stretch
- Somatic Yoga
- Breathwork-focused practices
- Specialty themed classes

What to Bring

- Yoga mat
- Water bottle (optional)

We have extra yoga mats available if you need one.

No additional props are required.

Included with every class:

- Water
- Tea
- Club soda

Stay after class for a few minutes to hydrate, connect, and build community.

Every class may be different, but you can always expect:

- Breath-centered movement
- Mindful instruction
- Options for different experience levels
- Nervous system regulation
- Strength, flexibility, and mobility
- A welcoming, judgment-free environment
- Community and connection

Whether it's your first class or your hundredth, you'll leave feeling more connected to yourself than when you walked in.

Come as you are. Leave a little more grounded, a little more open, and a little more at home in your body.

title: Garba King - Kirtidan Gadhvi Live In Columbus
description: A Night of Cultural Fusion with Garba King - Kirtidan Gadhvi Live in Columbus
long_description:
A Night of Cultural Fusion with Garba King - Kirtidan Gadhvi Live in Columbus
Experience a magical night of music, dance, and devotional singing with the Garba King, Kirtidan Gadhvi, live in Columbus. On September 11th, 2026, immerse yourself in the vibrant rhythms of Hindi, Gujarati, and multilingual songs that transcend borders and unite hearts. This Navratri/Dandiya event will be an unforgettable journey through the rich tapestry of Indian folk tradition, underlining the power of music to evoke emotions and create lasting memories.
Kirtidan Gadhvi: The Voice That Echoes Folk Tradition
Introducing Kirtidan Gadhvi, a luminary in the world of folk music whose soulful renditions have struck a chord with audiences of all ages. Kirtidan's profound understanding of dayras, folk songs, and his mastery over classical nuances have rightfully earned him the title of 'Garba King.' His music is not just a performance, but a heartfelt expression of his deep-rooted love for culture and tradition, captivating everyone who has the pleasure of listening.
The Greater Columbus Convention Center: A Venue Steeped in Grandeur
The event will be held at the Greater Columbus Convention Center, located at 400 N High St, Columbus, OH, United States. Known for its safety, accessibility, and state-of-the-art facilities, this venue is a popular choice for major events. Plenty of parking is available for attendees, and the area is surrounded by a host of attractions. To complete your cultural experience, we recommend visiting nearby Indian restaurants that serve authentic delicacies, adding a special touch to your evening.
Your Ticket to a Musical Extravaganza
Join us for an extraordinary evening by securing your tickets today. We offer a range of ticket options to suit your preferences. General Admission is priced at $35.00, while a group of 5+ attendees can avail of a discounted rate of $30.00 per ticket. For a more exclusive experience, opt for our VIP tickets at $50.00, or go all out with our VVIP tickets priced at $100.00. For those wishing to attend multiple shows, we offer a Combo Ticket for the shows on September 11th, 13th, October 2nd, and 3rd at a total cost of $90.00. Don't miss out on this cultural spectacle, book your seats now!

title: Yoga Sutras with Kate Holcombe
description: Join Yoga Philosophy and Sanskrit scholar, Kate Holcombe, for an inspiring and insightful workshop on the  history of Yoga philosophy.
long_description:
Join Yoga Philosophy and Sanskrit scholar, Kate Holcombe, for an inspiring and insightful workshop on the history of Yoga philosophy.

About this Event

Join Yoga Philosophy and Sanskrit scholar, Kate Holcombe, for an inspiring and insightful workshop on the history of Yoga philosophy and specifically, the richness of the Yoga Sutras of Patanjali. In this workshop we will primarily focus on the history of yoga philosophy as a means to help us reduce our experience of suffering and feel better in everyday life. We will also explore the differences between yoga philosophy and Hinduism, and how these two distinct philosophical systems have become confused and enmeshed over time.
It is appropriate for yoga enthusiasts of all levels and will include both lecture and discussion.

Bio:
Kate is founder and director of Healing Yoga Foundation, a non-profit project of Commonweal dedicated to supporting and empowering individuals in their own health, healing, and personal development through yoga, regardless of ability, background, experience, or financial means.

Kate began her yoga education in 1991 as a student of T.K.V. Desikachar in Chennai, India, returning many times for extended periods of intensive one-on-one study until his death in 2016. In conjunction with her yoga studies, Kate has studied Sanskrit at UC Berkeley, and the Kuppuswami Sastri Research Institute (Madras Sanskrit College) in Chennai, India.

Kate leads workshops and trainings for students around the country and is a popular writer, lecturer, teacher trainer, and yoga therapist. She is known for her practical, straightforward approach, her clarity and authenticity, and her relatable examples.

description: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening Classes will guide you through complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual wisdom. An ongoing in-depth course deliving into profound wisdom within Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Hindu/Indian/Vedic spiritual philosophy, and Upanishads. You can see prior recordings at: YesVedanta.com/bg2 Timeless Wisdom of Bhagavad Gita: A Complete Course in Non-Duality in 700 Verses Join us for an in-depth exploration of the Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Vedantic wisdom. Our weekly live Zoom classes will guide you through the complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual knowledge. The Bhagavad Gita, a dialogue between Krishna (the teacher) and Arjuna (the student), addresses life's deepest questions: What is the nature of the Self? What is the highest purpose of existence? How can one live with intelligence and clarity? If all existence is One, why do we perceive differences? What is the nature of the universe and its origin? How can we understand the cause of the universe? How does one transcend the sense of limitation? This comprehensive study covers: The nature of the Self (Atman) and Reality (Brahman) Self-knowledge that includes dozens of methods to reveal your nature The role of karma, dharma, and free will The nature of the mind and consciousness (or awareness) The art of wise living and decision-making Cultivating emotional maturity and inner peace Through this course, you will: Grasp the core teachings of the Bhagavad Gita and their relevance to modern life Apply practical techniques for refining your thinking and mastering your emotions Develop a deeper understanding of your identity and the world Cultivate inner peace, clarity, and purpose This knowledge offers a step-by-step method to liberate the seeker from the confines of the ego, from the limitations imposed by the material world, and from the cycle of rebirth. STOP RUNNING! WHAT ARE YOU AVOIDING? SHOW UP!

Weird times we're living in, no wonder most of us are living numb.... scrolling mindlessly on our phones, spending money on things we don't need, and running around chasing our tails getting nowhere fast.

This 200 Hour Foundational Yoga Teacher Training program is an emergency cord, a lifeline for you to stop letting the noise distract you, to wake up and self-regulate, so that you can integrate this very real and, sometimes, very heavy experience of being an eternal spirit soul experiencing this crazy material world from inside a very temporary physical body. 

In this program, we train your attention, your nervous system, and your voice so that you can truly connect to the truth of what matters most and meet your life with authenticity. You'll learn everything you need to know to be an incredible yoga teacher, but more importantly, you'll learn how to focus, breathe, and feel, to choose your lived experience with intention. 

You’ll leave with:

-Self-trust in your unshakable ability to deal with real-world stress

-Aligned action over old patterns, negative self-talk, self-deprecating habits, and avoidance

-Courage to be happy, feel deeply, connect with others, and stay present no matter what

Asana (Postures): A deep dive into the foundational poses, including alignments, modifications, benefits, and how to sequence them into flows or sets.

Pranayama (Breathing): Various techniques like Nadi Shodhana, Ujjayi, Kapalbhati, Bhramari, and their effects on prana (life force).

Anatomy & Physiology: Understand the myofascial structures of the body, how each part relates to the other parts, and how functional movement works in the field of gravity. Learn injury prevention and how yoga impacts the body.

title: 50-Hr Yin Yoga Immersion & Teacher Training
description: 50-Hr Yin Yoga Immersion & Teacher Training
long_description:
Deepen your understanding of Yin Yoga through anatomy, fascia, meridian theory, mindfulness, meditation, and skillful teaching practices.

About this Event

PROGRAM OVERVIEWThis 50-hour Yin Yoga Immersion & Teacher Training offers a deep exploration of Yin Yoga as both a contemplative practice and a skillful teaching methodology. Rooted in the principles of stillness, time, and mindful awareness, this training explores how Yin Yoga supports physical health, emotional balance, and energetic harmony.

Through guided practice, lecture, discussion, and teaching practicum, participants will study the foundations of Yin Yoga, the biomechanics of fascia and connective tissue, Chinese meridian theory, and the role of mindfulness and meditation within the practice. You will learn how Yin postures influence the body’s connective tissues, stimulate energetic pathways, and create space for deeper self-awareness.

Beyond the physical practice, Yin Yoga invites us to slow down and listen inwardly. By spending time in stillness, we begin to observe the patterns of body and mind that shape our experience. Over time, the practice becomes a mirror that reveals both habitual tension and an untapped inner sanctuary.

Participants will also develop the practical skills needed to teach Yin Yoga with confidence and integrity — including sequencing, pose architecture, intelligent use of props, and the language of mindfulness that helps students safely explore their edge.

This training is open to yoga teachers, dedicated practitioners, and wellness professionals who wish to deepen their understanding of Yin Yoga, develop a sustainable personal practice, and learn how to guide others toward the restorative and transformative benefits of this practice.

Many participants join not only to learn how to teach Yin Yoga, but also to deepen their own relationship with stillness, self-awareness, and nervous system balance. This training offers space for both professional development and personal ex

title: I Meditate CLE
description:
Let's Meditate CLE! Come to Cleveland's 7th annual mass meditation and create a collective consciousness of ONE mind!  When like-minded people gather with elevated intentions, it will create an energetic ripple that can benefit for all beings. 
Join several of Cleveland's yoga and meditation leaders
long_description:
Let's Meditate CLE! Come to Cleveland's 7th annual mass meditation and create a collective consciousness of ONE mind! When like-minded people gather with elevated intentions, it will create an energetic ripple that can benefit for all beings. 

Join several of Cleveland's yoga and meditation leaders to help raise the vibrations in our city and send out healing energy to Mother Earth.

During these times of division, we must journey from the mind into the heart for the greater good of all life on the planet and for the generations to come. In every wisdom tradition, meditation hasn’t been just a way to seek inner knowledge. It has the potential to transform the world. 

Research on the power of group meditation has been ongoing for decades, and the results have shown extremely positive social, political and economic results correlated to synchronized group meditations.

Experienced meditation teachers will lead you in techniques such as Mindfulness, Breathwork, Loving Kindness Meditation (Metta) and more. The event will conclude with a sound bath and kirtan (call and response community chanting).

Our group sing-along will give you a chance to share your voice as we chant peace mantras: Lokah Samastha Sukhino Bhavantu (May All Beings Be Happy & Free) and Om Shanti. 

This event is hosted and founded by Denys Morgan and with the support of her other volunteer co-facilitators. You can DM Denys on Instagram @IMeditateCLE if have questions or would like to volunteer.

This year, we will feature a heartfelt tribute to the remarkable life of former presenter Vonita Burke. A representative from My Village Yoga will guide a special meditation in her memory.

We will meet on the large grassy space in front of the FREE STAMP at Willard Park on the corner of E. 9th St and Lakeside. 

In case of inclement weather, the event will be rescheduled. Please check this event page or our Instagram page 1 hour before the event for confirmation if the weather looks untenable.

long_description:
You're invited to the best play date of the year.
Who's inviting you? Your inner child. And they want you to know; it's been too long since the two of you spent time together doing things that bring you joy and wonder.

Senseful Wellness is pairing up with Ayla Claypool for an afternoon that is equal parts intentional and delightfully unserious. A three-hour hang designed for the part of you that still knows how to play.
Ayla will guide everyone through a series of games using techniques from physical theatre theorist Jacques Lecoq in order to open our spacial and emotional awareness and take steps toward transformation. Exploratory and silly, serious play asks everyone the question of what does it mean to move like a kid again. To find the joy.

Vi will open and close the Playshop calling in your inner child and creating the container for them to actually show up and stay a while.

Jenn will move everyone through an Inner Child Vinyasa Flow, designed for all bodies and all ages.
Together we have created an afternoon that gives your inner child permission to flourish, and reminds everyone that we are all still big kids at heart.

Come play with us.

title: FREE Sahaja Yoga Meditation - every Sunday
description: FREE Sahaja Yoga Meditation - every Sunday Join us for Sahaja Yoga Meditation, a simple and natural technique that helps you connect with your inner self and experience true silence! A scientific study about the beneficial effects of Sahaja Yoga Meditation on the brain has just been published in PLOS ONE, a major neuroscience journal. It reveals that regular practitioners of Sahaja Yoga meditation have larger (around 7%) grey matter overall. In addition, the parts of the brain which are responsible for attention, self-control, emotion control, compassion, and introspection are more developed. Given that grey matter declines with age, this means that regular practitioners of Sahaja Yoga have younger brains. Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi is the founder of Sahaja Yoga. She is widely acknowledged as one of the greatest spiritual teacher of our times. The knowledge of Sahaja Yoga is ancient, and existed in the traditions of many religions and cultures. However it was known only by very few people. It is thanks to Shri Mataji that it has become widely available, in a way that many people can get self-realization quickly, and easily. With practice of Sahaja Yoga, anyone can have direct access to truth, and therefore become their own spiritual guide. Shri Mataji traces her ancestry back to the royal Shalivahana dynasty of India. She was born Nirmala Salve, and upon marriage became Nirmala Srivastava. Her husband was Sir C.P. Srivastava, who in the course of his illustrious career, was unanimously elected four times consecutively to the most senior position in the United Nationsâ€™ International Maritime Organization, thus serving as the Secretary-General from 1974 to 1989.

Our weekly live Zoom classes will guide you through the complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual knowledge. The Bhagavad Gita, a dialogue between Krishna (the teacher) and Arjuna (the student), addresses life's deepest questions: What is the nature of the Self? What is the highest purpose of existence? How can we understand the cause of the universe? How does one transcend the sense of limitation? description: An Iyengar-based yoga class of release, reflection, and return to welcome the Jewish New Year.
long_description:
An Iyengar-based yoga class of release, reflection, and return to welcome the Jewish New Year.

About this Event

Prepare for the Jewish New Year by slowing down, taking a breath, and making space for what's ahead. In this all-levels workshop, Julie Emden, founder of Embodied Jewish Learning, blends Iyengar-inspired yoga with Jewish wisdom to help you reflect, recharge, and reconnect. Through mindful movement and meaningful conversation, you'll let go of the past year, reconnect with yourself, and welcome the new one with greater clarity and intention. 
No prior yoga experience or Hebrew knowledge required. Come as you are, ready to stretch into the new year. 
ABOUT THE FACILITATOR: 
Julie Emden brings over two decades of experience weaving somatic practice with Jewish wisdom traditions. Her facilitation invites participants to connect more deeply with the High Holidays through body, breath, and soul. A graduate of multiple fellowship and certification programs including Dance Midrash, Yoga and Jewish Spirituality, Movement-based Expressive Arts and Iyengar-based Yoga, Julie draws from over 25 years of experience guiding others in embodied explorations of Jewish teachings as a pathway to balance and wholeness.

title: Soul Flow After Dark : Clarity, Balance & Presence
description: Explore the Three Gunas through Mental Yoga, Soul Flow, sound healing, music, and meaningful community connection.
long_description:

About this Event

Soul Flow After Dark is a Mental Yoga experience that blends community dialogue, Kriya Yoga, sound healing, music, and conscious connection.
This summer series explores the Three Gunas, the ancient yogic forces that influence our thoughts, emotions, behaviors, and relationships. Each evening begins with guided Mental Yoga inquiry and group discussion, helping participants explore the patterns shaping their lives. We then move into an energizing Kriya Yoga practice designed to elevate endorphins, increase awareness, and prepare the mind and body for deeper self study, surrender, and transformation.
The evening concludes with a restorative sound bath followed by music, community, and connection.

title: Whispers of Autumn: Yoga & Sound Bath
venue_name: 4 Sawmill Rd, Medford, NJ, United States, New Jersey 08055
description: Whispers of Autumn: Yoga & Sound Bath
long_description:
Join us for another season of Yoga at Cedar Run! All levels are welcomed. This will be a slow vinyasa/yin class. Some flow movement with some deep yin holds! Intentional movement progressing towards strength and healing to make you feel invigorated and relaxed. Breathe in the healing energy of the natural surroundings, heal yourself as you contribute to healing the animals around you.

We will be enjoying our morning yoga in the nature setting of the Pine Barrens. Surrounded by the sounds of nature, the smells of the forest and the morning air, it is sure to calm your mind, body and spirit. This session we will be stretching out in our Wildlife Housing Pavilion as we will take in the sun setting into evening. We will have tea at the nature center as well to help get your body and mind calm, replenished and ready for this session!

Please arrive 10 minutes early at our Nature Center Community Room to use the restroom and check in. If you would like to visit some of our resident wildlife after class we would happy for you to self explore. We would love to introduce you to our friends! Class will start at 6:30pm. 

Please bring your own yoga mat as we do not offer rentals. Props are optional. We have a water refill station for any reusable water bottles. 

Class size of 10. Limited space is available! Grab your spot before we sell out!

Children between the ages of 16-18 must be accompanied by an adult/parent.

No children under 16 may be permitted in the yoga session.

Meet your instructor: Monica Walsh – High Vibrations Association

Monica was first introduced to yoga when her mom brought her to her first class that a friend was teaching at a Synagogue in the late 90s. They attended the class because Monica’s relationship to her newly developing teenage body was not a healthy one. This beautiful, simple, practice opened her eyes to a new path with which to approach the human condition both on and off the mat. Ever since, Monica’s desire for yogic knowledge snowballed

long_description:
Maybe you don't yoga. Or pilates. But you love animals and want to just chill with goats? Join us for a heartwarming and joy-filled experience!

You can arrive anytime between 2-3 PM. 

Similar to the Japanese practice of spending mindful, therapeutic time sitting or walking in nature - Shinrin-yoku, which literally translates to "forest bathing". Developed in the 1980s, the practice involves immersing yourself in the forest atmosphere and engaging with nature through all five of your senses. Welcome to the goat forest!

Our distinguished Key Speakers include the charming goats - Nigerian Dwarf and Mini Silky Fainting ready to share their love and positive energy with all attendees.

Escape the routine and immerse yourself in a therapy session with nature. Whether you prefer to nap or play there's something for everyone. Simply relax in a lawn chair or hammock cuddle with a goat and watch your worries fade away. Feel the magic as time slips by and anxiety melts away in the serene farm setting.

This event is family-friendly so bring your loved ones and make cherished memories together. Please remember to bring your own beverage as our furry friends have a penchant for nibbling on snacks! 

Secure your tickets now through AllEvents and treat yourself to a one-of-a-kind experience that promises to destress and uplift your spirits. Say goodbye to holiday blues and hello to pure joy at "Cuddle with Goats and Puppies and Ducks on the Farm in Rockwall."

Please note that we do NOT accept walk-ins. All tickets must be bought in advance of the workshop either in-store or online. Ticket sales end at noon the day prior to the workshop.

Join us at The Sea Wych Salem for an autumn equinox/Mabon experience! We will be celebrating the second harvest, the balance between light and dark, and the turning of the seasonal tides and seas through a brief meditation, and of course, witch crafting. Create your own equinox/Mabon witch ball to celebrate your personal abundant harvest, give gratitude for that harvest, and to channel the energy needed to prepare for the coming autumn and winter. Not only will you be making your own magic, you'll be making your own, one-of-a-kind souvenir and memory from Salem. 

In addition to your witch ball, you'll also be going home with a full ritual kit which will include a sea shell, a tumbled moss agate, a tumbled sun stone, and red and orange spell candles for your altar, as well as all appropriate herbs and sea vegetation, a piece of sea glass, charms, and a ritual written by The Sea Wych Salem for the equinox - and autumn!

Tickets are $85 per person (plus a processing fee of $2.13), and that includes:

- All materials and supplies, including carnelian witch ball toppers made by The Sea Wych Salem specifically for this event, as well as a specially crafted charm.

- A brief history of the witch ball.

- A meditation and short ritual.

- A ritual kit as described above.

- The opportunity to shop privately, before or after the workshop, and a 10% discount on all store items.

description: Experience the Vibrancy of Gujarati Tradition with Ramo Re in the Bay Area
long_description:
Experience the Vibrancy of Gujarati Tradition with Ramo Re in the Bay Area
Get ready to immerse yourself in an unforgettable evening of music and dance at the "Ramo Re with Jigardan Gadhavi Garba 2026" on the 25th of September, 2026. This spellbinding event is a unique blend of traditional Gujarati folk music and contemporary sounds, woven together by the talented Jigardan Gadhavi. Experience the magic of Navratri/Dandiya in the heart of the Bay Area and sway to the rhythm of Gujarati, Hindi, Marathi, Punjabi, and Tamil beats.
Meet Jigardan Gadhavi - The Soulful Voice of Gujarat
Jigardan Gadhavi, better known as Jigrra, is a celebrated name in the Indian music industry. His roots in Gujarat have shaped his music, infusing it with the rich cultural heritage of the region. Jigardan's soulful voice and heartfelt compositions have captured the hearts of Gujarati folk, devotional, and contemporary music lovers alike. His popular hits like “Vhalam Aavo Ne” and “Mogal Taro Aashro” showcase his ability to fuse traditional Gujarati music with modern sounds, creating a unique listening experience for his audience.
Unwind at Baylands Park - The Perfect Venue for a Musical Evening
The event is set to take place at the scenic Baylands Park, located at 999 East Caribbean Drive, Sunnyvale, CA, United States. Baylands Park is renowned for its safety and accessibility, making it an ideal venue for families and friends to gather and enjoy an evening of music and dance. Plenty of parking is available at the venue. After the event, you could also explore the flavors of India at nearby Indian restaurants, adding the perfect end to your cultural extravaganza.
Grab Your Tickets for an Enthralling Evening
We offer a variety of ticket options to cater to all our guests. Early bird individual and group passes for the Open Air Garba are available at $35.00 and $32.00 respectively. If you are a fan of both Jigardan Gadhavi and Kinjal Dave, grab our combo tickets at early bird discounts of $60.00. We also offer general admission passes and group tickets for the Open Air Garba at $40.00 and $35.00 respectively. For an unforgettable experience, consider our Meet & Greet with Photo option at $100.00. Merchant Booths are also available at $250.00. title: Kids Yoga Teacher Training
description: A nature-based kids yoga training exploring mindfulness, play, and emotional regulation for parents, educators & caregivers.
long_description:
A nature-based kids yoga training exploring mindfulness, play, and emotional regulation for parents, educators & caregivers.

About this Event

Join Emily from Busy Being Kids Yoga at Gorman Heritage Farm on September 26th & 27th from 9 am to 4 pm for a nature-based Kids Yoga Teacher Training for adults to learn how to effectively teach yoga and mindfulness to children.
This immersive 20-hour training is designed for parents, educators, yoga instructors, and anyone who wants to support the emotional well-being of kiddos through movement, mindfulness, creativity, and play. No prior yoga certification is required.
Together, we will explore meaningful ways to help children regulate emotions, build confidence, process big feelings, connect with nature, and develop lifelong mindfulness tools in ways that feel engaging, supportive, and joyful.
The training blends yoga, mindfulness, breathwork, storytelling, music, games, creative expression, and nature-based activities that encourage curiosity, movement, creativity, and emotional wellness.
Participants will learn:
• Age-appropriate yoga poses and sequencing for children
• Breathing and mindfulness techniques to support emotional regulation
• Activities that encourage confidence, focus, creativity, and self-expression
• Nature-based mindfulness practices and sensory engagement
• Creative lesson planning using music, movement, games, and storytelling
• Tools for creating safe, playful, and supportive environments for children
Participants who complete the training will receive a 20-hour certification through Busy Being Kids Yoga that can be used toward teaching children’s yoga classes and incorporating mindfulness-based practices into educational, wellness, childcare, camp, and community settings.

About this Event

Join us for one of our quarterly Community Sound Bath Fundraisers and support a cause that brings movement, connection, and wellness to older adults throughout San Diego County.These special events are designed for anyone who believes in helping seniors thrive. 

Every ticket purchased helps Silver Age Yoga Community Outreach continue providing **FREE senior yoga classes at more than 17 locations throughout San Diego County, as well as live online classes**, ensuring that cost is never a barrier to healthy aging.

Each of our four annual sound baths features a different local San Diego wellness leader, sound healer, or spiritual practitioner, creating a unique experience every time you attend while showcasing the incredible healing community our city has to offer.

During a sound bath, you'll simply relax in a comfortable position while being immersed in the soothing sounds and vibrations of instruments such as crystal singing bowls, gongs, chimes, drums, and other healing instruments. 

There is no experience necessary—just come as you are and allow yourself to receive.Many participants report experiencing:

• Deep relaxation and stress relief
• A calmer, more balanced nervous system
• Greater mental clarity and emotional well-being
• Improved sleep and restoration
• A renewed sense of peace, presence, and connection

Whether you're looking for a meaningful way to support local seniors, nourish your own well-being, or connect with San Diego's vibrant healing community, our Sound Bath Fundraisers offer a beautiful opportunity to do all three.

Together, we can help more older adults experience the life-changing benefits of movement, mindfulness, and community.

You can see prior recordings at: YesVedanta.com/bg2 Timeless Wisdom of Bhagavad Gita: A Complete Course in Non-Duality in 700 Verses Join us for an in-depth exploration of the Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Vedantic wisdom. Our weekly live Zoom classes will guide you through the complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual knowledge. The Bhagavad Gita, a dialogue between Krishna (the teacher) and Arjuna (the student), addresses life's deepest questions: What is the nature of the Self? What is the highest purpose of existence? How can one live with intelligence and clarity? If all existence is One, why do we perceive differences? What is the nature of the universe and its origin? How can we understand the cause of the universe? How does one transcend the sense of limitation? This comprehensive study covers: The nature of the Self (Atman) and Reality (Brahman) Self-knowledge that includes dozens of methods to reveal your nature The role of karma, dharma, and free will The nature of the mind and consciousness (or awareness) The art of wise living and decision-making Cultivating emotional maturity and inner peace Through this course, you will: Grasp the core teachings of the Bhagavad Gita and their relevance to modern life Apply practical techniques for refining your thinking and mastering your emotions Develop a deeper understanding of your identity and the world Cultivate inner peace, clarity, and purpose This knowledge offers a step-by-step method to liberate the seeker from the confines of the ego, from the limitations imposed by the material world, and from the cycle of rebirth. description:

K-12 Educators are invited to join us for a FREE evening of professional learning, reflection, and connection at the Heard Museum. Held in recognition of the National Day of Remembran
long_description:
Explore Teacher Resources for discussing American Indian Boarding Schools & Indigenous resilience in the classroom!

K-12 Educators are invited to join us for a FREE evening of professional learning, reflection, and connection at the Heard Museum. Held in recognition of the National Day of Remembrance for U.S. Indian Boarding Schools, this special program will help educators approach classroom conversations about the American Indian boarding school era and its ongoing impacts with care, accuracy, and respect—while centering Indigenous resilience.

Through engagement with our program partner, the Arizona Department of Education’s Office of Indian Education, a special guest speaker, and a range of educational resources, participants will gain thoughtful perspectives and practical, classroom-ready ideas.

HERE'S WHAT'S INCLUDED:

• Exclusive after-hours gallery access to the Away From Home: American Indian Boarding School Stories exhibition.

• A presentation from the Office of Indian Education featuring historical and educational context and practical resources for classroom instruction.

• Insights about creative process and ideas for using literature to open age-appropriate conversations with elementary students provided by a special guest author.

• Opportunities to reflect, exchange resources, and network with fellow educators in the Phoenix area.

• A certificate for three hours of professional development credit.

Register now: https://heard.org/event/k-12-educator-night-beyond-the-boarding-schools/.

title: Hold the Light: A Yoga Practice
venue_name: 4 Sawmill Rd, Medford, NJ, United States, New Jersey 08055
description: Hold the Light: A Yoga Practice
long_description:
Join us for another season of Yoga at Cedar Run! All levels are welcomed. This will be a slow vinyasa/yin class. Some flow movement with some deep yin holds! Intentional movement progressing towards strength and healing to make you feel invigorated and relaxed. Breathe in the healing energy of the natural surroundings, heal yourself as you contribute to healing the animals around you.

We will be enjoying our morning yoga in the nature setting of the Pine Barrens. Surrounded by the sounds of nature, the smells of the forest and the morning air, it is sure to calm your mind, body and spirit. This session we will be stretching out in our Wildlife Housing Pavilion as we will take in the sun setting into evening. We will have tea at the nature center as well to help get your body and mind calm, replenished and ready for this session!

Please arrive 10 minutes early at our Nature Center Community Room to use the restroom and check in. If you would like to visit some of our resident wildlife after class we would happy for you to self explore. We would love to introduce you to our friends! Class will start at 6:30pm. 

Please bring your own yoga mat as we do not offer rentals. Props are optional. We have a water refill station for any reusable water bottles. 

Class size of 10. Limited space is available! Grab your spot before we sell out!

Children between the ages of 16-18 must be accompanied by an adult/parent.

No children under 16 may be permitted in the yoga session.

Meet your instructor: Monica Walsh – High Vibrations Association

Monica was first introduced to yoga when her mom brought her to her first class that a friend was teaching at a Synagogue in the late 90s. They attended the class because Monica’s relationship to her newly developing teenage body was not a healthy one. This beautiful, simple, practice opened her eyes to a new path with which to approach the human condition both on and off the mat. Ever since, Monica’s desire for yogic knowledge snowballed

* **Upa Yoga**: Activates the joints, muscles and energy system
* **AUMkar Meditation**: Enhances focus, memory and mind-body coordination
* **Nadi Shuddhi**: Balances and purifies the system

The practices are an effective preventative for obesity, asthma, sinusitis and other chronic ailments. The program is designed by Sadhguru and conducted by a highly trained instructor.

**Program Guidelines & session information**

* ***Attendance for all the sessions is essential. Since the practices are taught step-by-step, if you miss one session, it will not be possible for you to attend the subsequent following sessions***.
* Please make sure you arrive at least 10 minutes ahead of time, as we may not be able to accommodate latecomers.
* Due to the nature of the practices, we request you to maintain an empty stomach condition when you come for the session. There should be a gap of:
* 2.5 hours from the last full meal,
* 1.5 hours from the last snack,
* 1 hour from the last beverage (excluding water)
* It is recommended to wear comfortable (loose) clothing.
* Bring a yoga mat with you, and a cushion if needed as we will be sitting on the floor.
* As we strive to minimize waste, we recommend bringing a refillable water bottle with you. Refill stations are available.

The Salt Lake Healthy Life & Wellness Fair is an annual, free-admission community health event organized by a local regional non-profit organization. Moving into its 5th consecutive year, the event serves as a trusted cultural and clinical bridge in Salt Lake County.

description: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening Classes will guide you through complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual wisdom. An ongoing in-depth course deliving into profound wisdom within Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Hindu/Indian/Vedic spiritual philosophy, and Upanishads. You can see prior recordings at: YesVedanta.com/bg2 Timeless Wisdom of Bhagavad Gita: A Complete Course in Non-Duality in 700 Verses Join us for an in-depth exploration of the Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Vedantic wisdom. Our weekly live Zoom classes will guide you through the complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual knowledge. The Bhagavad Gita, a dialogue between Krishna (the teacher) and Arjuna (the student), addresses life's deepest questions: What is the nature of the Self? What is the highest purpose of existence? How can one live with intelligence and clarity? If all existence is One, why do we perceive differences? What is the nature of the universe and its origin? How can we understand the cause of the universe? How does one transcend the sense of limitation? This comprehensive study covers: The nature of the Self (Atman) and Reality (Brahman) Self-knowledge that includes dozens of methods to reveal your nature The role of karma, dharma, and free will The nature of the mind and consciousness (or awareness) The art of wise living and decision-making Cultivating emotional maturity and inner peace Through this course, you will: Grasp the core teachings of the Bhagavad Gita and their relevance to modern life Apply practical techniques for refining your thinking and mastering your emotions Develop a deeper understanding of your identity and the world Cultivate inner peace, clarity, and purpose This knowledge offers a step-by-step method to liberate the seeker from the confines of the ego, from the limitations imposed by the material world, and from the cycle of rebirth. About this Event

Come flow with us to benefit. Voices For Parkinson's provides in-person and telehealth speech therapy services for residents of Ohio. Individual, 1:1 services are currently provided at Alpha Neuro Fitness (800 E Ross Ave) in Cincinnati, OH. Weekly speech maintenance groups are offered via a hybrid approach, with the option for virtual and/or in-person attendance. The nonprofit organization offers a whole-person approach to treating the symptoms of Parkinson's disease, relating to problems with cognition, voice, and swallowing. We offer resources and education, and collaborate with an interdisciplinary team including local businesses to provide the most up-to-date information to our clients and their community.
100% of all donations go directly to the charity. We thank Fretboard Brewing for donating the space and Anissa Dowling for donating her time and talent in leading the yoga class that is always fun and perfect for all levels.

Fall Yoga Retreat: A Refuge for Your Heart

October 16-18, 2026

with Chaya Spencer at Lifebridge Sanctuary, Rosendale, NY

A true refuge is more than a place. It is a space where the mind grows quiet, the body softens, and the heart feels safe. It is where we can set down the weight of daily responsibilities, reconnect with what matters most, and remember the steady center that lives within us. In times of challenge, refuge restores us. In times of ease, it deepens our connection to ourselves and to one another.

Join us for a nourishing weekend retreat at Lifebridge Sanctuary, nestled in the beauty of the Catskills. Through yoga, meditation, time in nature, wholesome meals, meaningful conversation, and spacious periods of rest and reflection, you’ll be invited to slow down and settle into a deeper sense of presence and belonging.

In the yogic tradition, there is a beautiful Sanskrit phrase: hridaya vishranti—reposing in the heart. Here, “heart” does not refer to the physical organ or even the emotional heart, but to our essential nature, the innermost core of who we are. Vishranti means rest, repose, or deep relaxation. Together, these words point to the experience of resting in our own being, returning home to ourselves.

This retreat offers a supportive cocoon for renewal and self-discovery. Come away for a weekend of rest, connection, and renewal. Return home grounded, refreshed, and reconnected to the essence of who you are.

Our retreat center, Lifebridge Sanctuary, offers us a space of peace, nature and quiet to introspect, practice yoga, eat well and rest in beauty inside and out. The Sanctuary is a 12,000 square foot hand crafted, green facility on 95 acres of forest and spectacular open space on the Northern crest of the Shawangunk Ridge, less than 90 minutes from Shree.

title: REZN
venue_name: 7 S Broadway, Denver, CO, United States, Colorado 80209
description: REZN
long_description:
REZN – the Chicago-based band of Rob McWilliams (vocals, guitar), Phil Cangelosi (bass), Patrick Dunn (drums), and Spencer Ouellette (synth/saxophone) – announce their new album, Burden, out June 14th via their new label Sargent House. In conjunction, they present its massive lead single/video, “Chasm.” Since their inception, REZN have mined the stark monochromatic depths of underground metal and fused them with the kaleidoscopic delights of psychedelia, prog rock, and shoegaze. With their latest album Burden, they plumb the deepest, bleakest trenches of their sound while retaining a lifeline into the cosmos. Staking a claim at the crossroads of the hazy dimensions of modern psych acts like Black Angels, the cavernous gloom and reverb-drenched guitar of bands like Spectral Voice, and the lurching low-end meditations of artists like OM, REZN have created Burden—an album of immense amp-worshipping weight and intoxicating instrumentation.

Burden was recorded simultaneously with their previous album Solace back in July 2021 at Earth Analog Studios in Tolono, IL by Matt Russell. Rather than release a double album, REZN divided the material into two separate records, each with its own distinct emotional timbre. Whereas Solace was meant to uplift and create a sense of narcotic dreaminess, Burden skews towards the themes of delirium, claustrophobia, and misery. Musically, Burden favors riffs over atmosphere, percussion over ether, dissonance over beauty, but there is still an undeniable cohesion between it and its predecessor. The marriage of brute force and sublime textures has always been a key tactic in REZN’s approach—a duality that may explain their touring history with fellow synesthesia-inducing metallurgists Elder and Russian Circles—but the spectrum of the band’s mercurial temperaments has never felt as clearly defined and fully explored as it does on Burden.

title: Trauma Informed Yoga Teacher Training
venue_name: Pilgrimage of the Heart Yoga - Normal Heights
description: Trauma informed yoga aims to create a welcoming space for anyone who is experiencing the difficulties that can result from traumatic events.
long_description:
Trauma informed yoga aims to create a welcoming space for anyone who is experiencing the difficulties that can result from traumatic events.

About this Event

Trauma is an emotional response to a stressful or disturbing incident or physical injury. When one experiences a traumatic event, it can create an inner environment that will affect many aspects of the survivor’s life. From a sense of disconnection to a dysregulated nervous system, the impact of trauma reaches both the mind and the body and can leave one with feelings of insecurity, overwhelm and powerlessness that can distance the survivor from their innate sense of joy and inner peace.
Yoga has many tools that can reconnect practitioners to their inner peace and well-being, but for those living with the inner wound of trauma, a regular yoga class may present challenges that keep them from enjoying the many benefits of the practice.
Trauma informed yoga aims to create a welcoming space for anyone who is experiencing the difficulties that can result from traumatic events.
Join Lauren McLaren to investigate the impact of trauma and explore how to make your classes inclusive and sensitive to the needs of those who are living with the effects of trauma.
During this 14-hour training, you will learn:
How trauma can affect physical health and well-beingThe neurobiology of trauma and how yoga can assist in regulating the nervous system to help reconnect the body/mind systemsHow to use practices including asana, pranayama, mudra and mindfulness to promote empowerment and agencyHow to honor trauma survivors in yoga classes by tailoring language and cues, providing consistency in structure, and offering modificationsThis training is perfect for teachers who want to create a more inclusive teaching environment as well as for practitioners who are looking to advance their knowledge in how yogic tools can serve this population.
Please note that this training is not intended to empower teachers to diagnose or treat trauma

The fourth full-length from Basement, Beside Myself is an intimate look at the drawbacks of living in your own head, and the attempt to shake off everyday anxieties. “One of the things everyone in the band seems to struggle with is living fully in the present time,” says Andrew Fisher, who co-founded the Ipswich, England-bred five-piece in 2010. “We tend to look back on the past and think, ‘That was so much better than what’s going on now,’ or look toward the future and assume it’s going to be better than today. The title came from thinking about, ‘Wouldn’t it be great if you could stop yourself from doing that, and just appreciate the moment as it happens?’” 

But for all its intense introspection and confessions of self-consciousness, Beside Myself centers on a powerful, passionately charged sound that makes every track feel deeply cathartic. A relentless burst of pure vitality, the album expresses its unrest in the language of furious guitar riffs and visceral rhythms. And at the heart of Beside Myself are Basement’s indelible melodies, an element that lends an anthemic quality to even the most heavy-hearted songs. 

The follow-up to Promise Everything—a 2016 album whose re-release the following year marked Basement’s debut for Fueled by Ramen—Beside Myself was co-produced by the band and Colin Brittain, and mixed by Rich Costey (Arctic Monkeys, Foo Fighters, Muse). title: Diwali On The Hudson

What began as an intimate community gathering has grown into a sold-out, flagship annual event, welcoming friends, professionals, creatives, and changemakers for an unforget
long_description:
Now in its 13th year, Diwali on the Hudson returns as one of New York City's largest and most anticipated Diwali celebrations. What began as an intimate community gathering has grown into a sold-out, flagship annual event, welcoming friends, professionals, creatives, and changemakers for an unforgettable night honoring the Festival of Lights, while supporting the transformative work of the Desai Foundation.

Hosted at HK Hall in the heart of Hell's Kitchen, the evening blends culture, celebration, and impact through live entertainment, Indian food, dancing, and meaningful connection with a vibrant community. Over the years, the event has welcomed celebrities, influencers, and community leaders, earning recognition from outlets including Good Morning America.

More than a party, Diwali on the Hudson is a space to gather in joy and intention, celebrating culture while learning how the Desai Foundation empowers women and children across rural India through health, livelihood, and menstrual equity programs.

title: Goat Yoga in The Patch @ Bedford Public Library!
description: Goat Yoga in The Patch @ Bedford Public Library!
long_description:
Come and join us for Goat Yoga in The Patch hosted by the Bedford Public Library!

About this Event 
 https://cdn-az.allevents.in/events2/banners/dcb6ced0-87e3-11f1-b6c8-ef4137d8dcb0-rimg-w663-h740-dca7c3f1-gmir.jpg 

YOU are invited to GOAT YOGA in BEDFORD, TX! Come and get your yoga on while our tribe of pet goats graze and jump around (or on) you! We will be in the pumpkin patch at the Bedford Public Library! Come as you are or dressed up in Halloween costume attire. The goats will be in costume!
Please come dressed for the weather as the event will be outside. Proceeds from this class directly benefit our animals and our local non-profit initiatives. 

Know before you go:
*Please do not enter the fenced off goat yoga area any earlier than 15 minutes before your scheduled class time. We will set aside time after class for extra socializing and picture taking with the goats if you don't get the shot you want during yoga practice.
 *BYOM (bring your own yoga mat) We do not provide mats, but we do provide beach towels for all attendees to use. We also provide bottled waters, sunscreen, bug spray, etc.
*Be prepared for our goats to take an interest in you! They are excited to be with you! Goat yoga is for everyone, and we welcome participants age 5 and over (with a participating parent or guardian). It is meant to be fun and memorable. Goats have been known to nudge, scratch, nibble, jump and step on attendees. Goats are NOT potty trained animals. There will be a sanitizing station and antibacterial wipes available.
*Everyone will need to check in and sign our liability waiver before the class starts. Masks are not required. This is an outdoor fitness event. Social distancing will be the responsibility of each participant in regards to their own preferences in proximity to other attendees.

Our tribe looks forward to meeting you!

Let us know if you have any questions or if we can provide you with any additional information - we look forward to hosting you!

long_description: Known as 'The People's Marathon,' the Marine Corps Marathon is the third-largest marathon in the US and the world's largest without prize money. The 51st edition takes runners on a spectacular tour of Washington DC — past the Pentagon, along the Potomac, through Georgetown, around the National Mall, and past the Capitol. Registration opens April 6.

title: Body & Soul Art Intensive with Alex Grey & Allyson Grey
description: Body & Soul Art Intensive with Alex Grey & Allyson Grey
long_description:
ABOUT THE PROGRAM

Body & Soul Art Intensive is a creative spiritual practice and visionary ritual intended to turn on the Light Body. Multiple systems of subtle healing life energies run through and surround our body. Seven Chakras, witnessed and reported by clairvoyants as "wheels of light,” ascend the spine and color our emotions and aspirations.

This drawing ritual challenges us to depict the model’s nude presence and encourages us to imagine and portray bio-energetic radiant auras that extend beyond the skin.

WHAT TO EXPECT

Drawing begins on the first morning of the workshop. Each of the seven chakra drawings are briefly introduced by a short guided meditation to consider the energetic force-field associated with the chakra we are about to portray. 

Each participant will create seven drawings focusing on the character and hue of one chakra. Each drawing period is forty-five minutes long, working with meditative focus. The exercise is accompanied by a thematic musical playlist highlighting the archetypal meaning of each chakra. 

To introduce each drawing, a brief blessing describes the meaning, color and vibration of that energy center, identifying specific organs and nerve bundles that correspond within the body. The subject of each drawing is a yogini, a nude model who stands, sits or lies still for class members to draw or paint. 

YOUR INSTRUCTORS

Alex Grey & Allyson Grey

Alex Grey, world-renowned artist, poet, and author, is best loved for his paintings which portray multiple dimensions of reality, interweaving biological anatomy with psychic and spiritual energies. His books, Sacred Mirrors, The Mission of Art, Transfigurations, and Art Psalms, trace the development of his work and mystical experiences that shaped his spiritual artistic life. Alex’s most recent monograph, Net of Being, addresses how his art is evolving the cultural body through icons of interconnectedness. alexgrey.com

description: Join us for an all-levels yoga class to benefit the mission of Give Like a Mother - Clothing Kids in Confidence
long_description:
Join us for an all-levels yoga class to benefit the mission of Give Like a Mother - Clothing Kids in Confidence

About this Event

Come flow with us to benefit Give Like a Mother. Give Like A Mother (GLAM) is a nonprofit dedicated to ensuring that local children and teens in need have access to seasonally appropriate clothing.
Though we operate on donations of gently used items, we are committed to providing high-quality, in-style clothing that kids can wear with confidence. When children feel good about what they’re wearing, it can boost their self-worth, reduce the risk of ridicule, and ultimately support their success in school and beyond.
Our name may be fun and a little sassy, but it carries a serious challenge. Mothers give everything they can for their children—yet sometimes, even that isn’t enough.
That’s why we’re asking you: Will you Give Like A Mother and help a child in need?
100% of all donations go directly to the charity. We thank Fretboard Brewing for donating the space and Anissa Dowling for donating her time and talent in leading the yoga class that is always fun and perfect for all levels.
Bring a friend and enjoy $1 off beers in the tap room after class!

description:
Join Susanna Barkataki for this Friday night class! A coming home to your own body, breath, and belonging  grounded in the ancient roots of the practice and the wisdom of trauma-informed teaching.

We begin where yoga has always begun: with sound. With gentle movement, slow shapes, philosophy and br
long_description:
Join Susanna Barkataki for this Friday night class! A coming home to your own body, breath, and belonging grounded in the ancient roots of the practice and the wisdom of trauma-informed teaching.

We begin where yoga has always begun: with sound. With gentle movement, slow shapes, philosophy and breath.

Rooted in the tradition's own understanding that the nervous system is sacred, and the body is not something to push through but something to listen to, Susanna Barkataki guides you through an accessible, embodied practice that weaves pranayama, gentle movement, mantra, and meditation into a single living experience.

This is yoga as the tradition always intended it, a path toward wholeness for every body.

You will leave feeling grounded, held, and more at home in yourself than when you walked in.

long_description: The BMW Dallas Marathon has been a Texas running tradition for over 40 years. The race weekend features a full marathon, half marathon, ultra marathon, 5-person relay, 10K, and 5K — something for every runner. The course starts at Dallas City Hall, loops through scenic White Rock Lake, and finishes back downtown. Since 1997, the marathon has donated nearly $5 million to Scottish Rite for Children. venue_info: Start/finish at Dallas City Hall, 1500 Marilla St. The course is flat and fast, passing through downtown Dallas and around White Rock Lake (120m total elevation gain). DART light rail serves the City Hall area. Post-race party with food, beer, and live music.
